hero.heading: Ship faster with one connected workflow
hero.body: Bring planning, work, and reporting into a single place your team already understands.

items.title: Automations
items.body: Replace repetitive steps with rules that run themselves.

items.title: Real-time dashboards
items.body: See status, blockers, and trends without exporting a thing.

items.title: Secure by default
items.body: SSO, granular roles, and audit logs on every plan.

items.title: Growth
items.body: For scaling teams that need automation and analytics.

items.title: Enterprise
items.body: Advanced security, SSO, and dedicated support.

faqs.title: Is there a free plan?
faqs.body: Yes — the Starter plan is free for small teams, with no time limit.

faqs.title: Can I migrate my existing data?
faqs.body: Import from CSV or connect a source; our team helps with larger migrations.

faqs.title: How does billing work?
faqs.body: Per active seat, billed monthly or annually. Change plans anytime.
